_doc: Cortex LoCoMo benchmark baseline. The TS port must reproduce these scores within ±0.5 percentage points. CANONICAL SOURCE: the published Cortex numbers in docs/arxiv-thermodynamic/main.pdf (Table tab:benchmarks, Empirical Evidence) — LoCoMo MRR 0.8278, R@10 94.2%. Those are the only two LoCoMo metrics the paper publishes (retrieval recall + MRR, directly comparable to published retrieval baselines). recall_at_5 and by_category below are NOT in the paper; they are kept as a conservative secondary gate from the empirical cortex_bench capture (cortex@1ef1376, 2026-04-17). The published methodology (paper Empirical Evidence): clean PostgreSQL DB seeded only with the benchmark data, single process, the same recall_memories() PL/pgSQL code path as deployment — exactly what the cortex-locomo-pg runner exercises (NOT the SQLite custom-retriever path, which only approximates PG signal values).
